title: write-pace: raise DEFAULT_HOURLY_MAX from 40 to 80 writes per token-hour; keep the min gap, lease, batch gap and back-off stop marker unchanged
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AdARJtc4RgABPH7PHk

Filing gate: **③ a task on the maintainer's word.** The account owner, verbatim, in `session_012dn2AdARJtc4RgABPH7PHk`: 「写入配额临时增加到80」, then 「同意」 to the seat's brief recommending option C (change the default rather than a per-role environment override), after an independent re-analysis. Reader: triage routes (expected `domain:skills`, non-gate PM tooling in `scripts/pm/`).

## 维护者速读

车队每个账号令牌每小时最多 40 次 GitHub 写入(`write-pace.mjs` 默认值)。席位和它派出的开发共用同一个令牌和同一份计数;今天席位临时用测试专用的环境变量把自己提到 80,开发仍按 40 被拒,最长等了 25 分钟。改法:把默认值改成 80,所有人自动一致;防封真正靠的「最小间隔、全队单写租约、批量间隔、遇平台退避即停」都不动。

## Facts (from the script header on `main`)

- The suspensions that motivated the pace were a RATE shape (17 issues in 29 s), stopped by rules ① min gap, ③ back-off stop marker, ④ fleet-wide single in-flight lease, ⑤ batch gap; the hourly cap ② is the second guard.
- The budget is per token over a shared log, so seat and devs in one container share one count; `OS_PM_WRITE_HOURLY_MAX` is documented as a FOR-TESTS override, the wrong carrier for production pace.
- Dev refusals today were rule ② (reports: "51/40", "55 of 40 on the shared token").

## Ask

- `DEFAULT_HOURLY_MAX` 40 → 80, the header's rationale updated with the ruling quote and the residual risk (several containers on one token add up; keep concurrent containers per token small), the self-test updated. No other rule changes.

Priority: p2.
